items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: John relayed to me the fact that Spike was coming and he would like to use my band

ctx.x: Oh, he said very, very nice things about you -- he said that you were the only one, you immediately understood his music and he didn't think that anybody else could see it as quickly as you saw it, and it was a great honor to have his music played by your band, which he thought was, if not the greatest, then certainly one of the greatest, and so on.

I don't ... I don't think so. I think maybe we had a rehearsal away from the studio, you know. But there wasn't a great deal. He had the music all written; everything, you know, was his arrangement and his composition, with the exception of Gabriel's Horn -- I think Someone stole "Gabriel's Horn" which I did the infamous vocal, bogo-on.
But no, everything was just done in the proper fashion.
